meta.title: 第36讲 · 动名词① 自学
meta.subtitle: 自学一遍再上课：热身认识非谓语三兄弟 → 动名词四大句法功能 → 作主语（谓语三单 + it 形式主语）→ 作宾语（doing 名单 + 介词 to 陷阱）→ like 家意义之变 → forget/remember/stop → regret/try/mean/go on → need 主动表被动 → 综合验收（共 9 关 · 55 题。作业卷留到课后当考试，这里不剧透）

nodes.title: ① 热身：非谓语三兄弟，本讲主角 doing
nodes.explain:
从这一讲起，我们进入「非谓语动词」大区——在句中不能单独作谓语的动词形式。三兄弟分别是：不定式 to do（34 / 35 讲的主角）、动名词 doing（本讲主角）、分词 -ing / -ed（后面再会）。

动名词的构成只有一条：动词原形 + ing。 Seeing is believing. 眼见为实——一句话里 doing 打了两份工（Seeing 作主语，believing 作表语）。它最像名词，能干四份活：

功能例句
主语Eating too much is bad for your health.
宾语I like playing basketball very much.
表语His hobby is collecting stamps.
定语She is in the reading room.

本大区主线就一刀：to do vs doing——什么时候只能用 doing，什么时候两者意思不一样。34 / 35 讲我们把 to do 讲透了，本讲轮到 doing 接棒，第 31 讲埋的伏笔（can't help doing、need doing）也会陆续回收。

自学方法：先读讲解 → 盖住答案做题 → 点「先想再看答案」核对 → 全懂了点「我学完了」进下一关。

general_qs.stem: 下面哪一项不属于非谓语动词？
general_qs.explain: 非谓语动词三兄弟：to do、doing、分词 -ing / -ed。情态动词（can / must…）是 31 讲的「态度词」，帮谓语站台，不属于非谓语阵营。

general_qs.stem: 动名词是怎么构成的？
general_qs.explain: do → doing，see → seeing，构成只有这一条。

general_qs.stem: Jack enjoyed ________ (run) around the park when he was free.
general_qs.explain: enjoy（喜欢）后面固定接 doing → running。这是 doing 名单上的第一个词，下一关还会整队点名。

general_qs.stem: Seeing is believing. 眼见为实。这句话的主语是？
general_qs.explain: 「看见」这件事当主语，is 是谓语，believing 作表语——动名词一句话干两份工。

general_qs.stem: ________ too much is bad for your health. (eat)
general_qs.explain: 「吃得太多」这件事作主语 → 动名词 Eating，句首 E 要大写。动词原形 Eat 不能直接当主语。

nodes.title: ② 动名词的四大句法功能
nodes.explain:
动名词长着动词的脸，干着名词的活。四大句法功能一张表看全：

功能例句怎么认
主语Eating too much is bad for your health.放句首，当「一件事」讲
宾语（动词宾语）I like playing basketball very much.跟在动词后面
宾语（介词宾语）Stamps are used for sending letters. = Stamps are used to send letters.跟在介词 for 后面
表语His hobby is collecting stamps. = Collecting stamps is his hobby.跟在 be 后面，说主语「是什么」
定语She is in the reading room.放在名词前，说明「用途」

注意定语这一格：reading room 的 reading 表示用途——阅览室不是「正在阅览」的房间，是「用来阅览」的房间，同理 a swimming pool 游泳池。表语位置有个对称现象：His hobby is collecting stamps. ↔ Collecting stamps is his hobby. 主表互换，句意不变。

记法：找 doing 的成分，先看它站在哪——句首是主语，动词/介词后面是宾语，be 后面是表语，名词前面是定语。

general_qs.stem: His hobby is collecting stamps. 画线的 collecting stamps 作什么成分？
general_qs.explain: 跟在 be 动词 is 后面、回答「hobby 是什么」→ 表语。对照：Collecting stamps is his hobby. 里它就换岗当主语了。

general_qs.stem: She is in the reading room. 画线的 reading 作什么成分？
general_qs.explain: reading 放在名词 room 前面说明用途——「用来阅览的」房间。这里的 doing 不表示动作正在进行。

general_qs.stem: Stamps are used for sending letters. sending letters 是什么成分？
options: 介词宾语（介词 for 的宾语）
general_qs.answer: B. 介词宾语（介词 for 的宾语）
general_qs.explain: for 是介词，介词后面的 doing 叫介词宾语。邮票「被用来寄信」——信是 for 的宾语里的事。

general_qs.stem: 同义转换：Stamps are used for sending letters. = Stamps are used ________ ________ letters.（2 词）
general_qs.explain: 讲义给的等价式：for sending = to send。介词 + doing 和不定式 to do 在这里互通。

general_qs.stem: 下面哪句的动名词作主语？
options: There is a swimming pool near my school.
general_qs.answer: B. Swimming is my favourite sport.
general_qs.explain: A 死于 like 后面是宾语；C 死于 is 后面是表语；D 死于 swimming pool 里 swimming 作定语；B 放句首当「一件事」讲 → 主语。

general_qs.stem: I like ________ (play) basketball very much.
general_qs.explain: like 后面接 doing 表示一直喜欢（习惯）→ playing。like 家 to do / doing 的区别下一关细讲。

nodes.title: ③ 动名词作主语：一件事 + 三单谓语
nodes.explain:
动名词作主语，说的是经常性、习惯性的一件事——谓语把整件事当「一个东西」看，用第三人称单数。

① Joining the English Club is a good way to improve our English.（加入英语俱乐部这件事，是个好办法）

② 主语嫌长时，请 it 先占座，动名词搬去句尾：

It is no good going there again. 再去那里也没好处。
It's no use crying over spilt milk. 覆水难收。（spill-spilt-spilt 洒出）

⚠️ 本大区主线第一刀——to do vs doing 作主语：平时可以互换，但分工不同——

to do 作主语doing 作主语
具体某一次的行为、将来的动作一般、抽象、笼统的概念，或已完成/习惯性的事

对照读：Smoking is not good for you.（抽烟——泛泛而谈这个习惯）vs It is not good for you to smoke so much.（你抽这么多——针对这一次、这种程度的具体行为）

记法：doing 是「老习惯」，to do 是「这一回」；动名词短语作主语，谓语一律三单。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习：动名词作主语（先想再点开）

general_qs.stem: ________ (join) the English Club is a good way to improve our English.
general_qs.explain: 「加入俱乐部」这件事作主语 → 动名词 Joining，放句首 J 大写。注意后面谓语是 is——动名词短语作主语按三单算。

general_qs.stem: Joining the English Club ________ a good way to improve our English.
general_qs.explain: 动名词短语作主语 = 一件事 → 谓语用三单 is。B 死于把一件事当复数；C / D 死于时态形式对不上一般现在时。

general_qs.stem: It's no use ________ (cry) over spilt milk.
general_qs.explain: it 先占主语的位置，真主语 crying 后置——It's no use doing 句型。整句意思：覆水难收，哭了也没用。

general_qs.stem: It is no good ________ (argue) with him. (argue)
general_qs.explain: It is no good doing 和 It's no use doing 是一对双胞胎句型：跟他争辩没好处 → arguing。

general_qs.stem: 不定式和动名词作主语，下面的说法哪个对？
options: 常可互换：to do 偏「具体某一次 / 将来」，doing 偏「一般、抽象、习惯」
to do 表习惯，doing 表具体一次（正好说反）
general_qs.answer: B. 常可互换：to do 偏「具体某一次 / 将来」，doing 偏「一般、抽象、习惯」
general_qs.explain: Smoking is not good for you.（习惯）vs It is not good for you to smoke so much.（这一次抽这么多）——A / D 死于一刀切；C 死于方向颠倒。

general_qs.stem: 想说「你抽这么多烟对身体不好」（针对这一次、这个程度），选哪句？
options: Smoking is not good for you.
It is not good for you to smoke so much.
To smoking is not good for you.
Smoke so much is not good for you.
general_qs.answer: B. It is not good for you to smoke so much.
general_qs.explain: 针对「抽这么多」这个具体行为 → it 形式主语 + to smoke。A 死于它是泛泛而谈抽烟习惯（题干强调「这么多」）；C 死于不定式 to 后面不能跟 doing；D 死于动词原形短语不能作主语。

memory.front: 动名词作主语，谓语动词用什么？it 形式主语有哪两个句型？
memory.back:
动名词作主语 = 一件事 → 谓语用三单
Joining the English Club is a good way to improve our English.
it 形式主语，动名词后置：
It is no good doing… / It's no use doing…
It's no use crying over spilt milk. 覆水难收
to do 具体一次 · doing 一般习惯（Smoking is bad ↔ to smoke so much）

nodes.title: ④ 动名词作宾语：doing 名单与介宾
nodes.explain:
动名词作宾语，表示一般的习惯、抽象行为或经常性的动作。分两种：

① 动宾——跟在动词后面：Would you mind giving me some advice on how to use an English dictionary?（能给我讲讲怎么用英语词典吗？）

哪些动词后面必须接 doing？名单要背：

单词类短语类
enjoy 喜欢 · finish 完成 · mind 介意 · practise 练习 · suggest / advise 建议 · admit 承认 · avoid 避免 · consider 考虑 · imagine 想象 · keep 保持be busy 忙于 · think of 想起 · think about 考虑 · be worth 值得 · can't help 情不自禁 · be good at / do well in 擅长 · be fond of 喜欢 · be / get used to 习惯于 · can't stand 无法忍受 · feel like 想要 · look forward to 盼望 · stick to 坚持 · succeed in 成功 · pay attention to 注意

⚠️ 名单里藏着一伙「假不定式」：look forward to、be / get used to、stick to、pay attention to 里的 to 都是介词——介词后面只能接 doing，别被 to 的外表骗去写原形。

② 介宾——跟在介词后面：We have to prevent the air from being polluted. 我们必须阻止空气被污染。from 是介词 → 后面接动名词；空气是「被污染」，所以用动名词的被动式 being done。

记法：动词名单背单词，介词后面必 doing；空气被污染，being done 来站岗。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 1：doing 名单与介宾（先想再点开）

general_qs.stem: I can't imagine ________ (live) without the internet.
general_qs.explain: imagine（想象）在 doing 名单上 → living。没法想象没有网络的生活。

general_qs.stem: I'm looking forward to ________ (see) you again soon.
general_qs.explain: look forward to 里的 to 是介词 → 后面接 doing → seeing。写成 to see 就掉进「假不定式」的坑；同伙还有 be / get used to、stick to、pay attention to。

general_qs.stem: We should consider ________ (take) a vacation next month.
general_qs.explain: consider（考虑）在 doing 名单上 → taking。e 结尾的 take 去 e 加 ing。

general_qs.stem: I can't help ________ (laugh) when I see his funny face.
general_qs.explain: can't help doing 情不自禁——第 31 讲的黄金搭配在这里回收 → laughing。

general_qs.stem: ________ (join) in the dance, everyone felt the joy of music.
general_qs.explain: 句子里已有谓语 felt，空格不能再填谓语动词 → 用 doing 形式 Joining 开头（句首大写），它的逻辑主语就是主句的 everyone：大家「参加」了舞会，才「感到」音乐之乐。

general_qs.stem: Would you mind ________ the window?
general_qs.explain: mind（介意）在 doing 名单上 → opening。Would you mind doing…? 是客气请求，讲义原句 Would you mind giving me some advice 就是这个用法；A 死于 mind 不接 to do。

general_qs.stem: We have to prevent the air from ________ (pollute).
general_qs.explain: from 是介词 → 后面接动名词；空气是「被污染」→ 被动动名词 being polluted。主动写 polluting 就成了空气污染别人。

general_qs.stem: 下面哪个动词后面必须接 doing？
general_qs.explain: finish 完成 → finish doing。hope / want / decide 都接 to do——它们不在 doing 名单上。

memory.front: 哪些动词后面必须接 doing？哪几个 to 是介词陷阱？
memory.back:
名单：enjoy / finish / mind / practise / suggest / advise / admit / avoid / consider / imagine / keep
口诀：享受完成不介意，练习建议避承认；考虑想象 keep 住，禁不住（can't help）忙不停（be busy）
短语：be worth · be good at / do well in · be fond of · can't stand · feel like · think of / about · succeed in
介词 to 陷阱：look forward to / be / get used to / stick to / pay attention to + doing

nodes.title: ⑤ begin / start 与 like / love / hate：意义变与不变
nodes.explain:
to do 和 doing 跟在动词后面，有的意思基本不变，有的意思大变——先记不变的那组：

动词规则例句
begin / start接 to do 或 doing 都行，意义变化不大begin to work = begin working
like / love / hateto do＝具体某一次去做；doing＝一直喜欢 / 讨厌（习惯）He hates getting up early on Sundays. / She hated to get up early this morning.

like 家这组要对比着读：

① He hates getting up early on Sundays.（Sundays 复数泛指每周日——一贯讨厌，习惯 → doing）

② She hated to get up early this morning.（this morning 就今天早上这一回——具体一次 → to do）

记法：doing 是「老习惯」，to do 是「就这一次」——和作主语时的分工一脉相承，本大区的主线刀法就是这一把。

general_qs.stem: He hates ________ up early on Sundays.（周日一向如此）
general_qs.explain: Sundays 泛指每周日，说的一贯习惯 → hate doing。A 死于 hate 后不能直接接动词原形；C 死于 to 后面不能接 doing；D 形式不对。

general_qs.stem: She hated ________ (get) up early this morning.（就今天早上这一回）
general_qs.explain: this morning 锁定「具体这一次」→ hate to do → to get。对照上一题的 on Sundays——一次和一贯，to do 和 doing 各管一头。

general_qs.stem: Class begins. Let's start ________.
options: to work 或 working 都对
general_qs.answer: C. to work 或 working 都对
general_qs.explain: begin / start 后接 to do 或 doing 意义变化不大，两个都对。这是 to do / doing 里唯一「随便选」的一组。

general_qs.stem: like / love / hate + doing 表示什么？
options: 一直喜欢 / 讨厌（习惯、一贯如此）
general_qs.answer: B. 一直喜欢 / 讨厌（习惯、一贯如此）
general_qs.explain: doing 表一贯：I like swimming = 我（一直）喜欢游泳。具体某一次「今天想去」才轮 to do 出场。

nodes.title: ⑥ forget / remember / stop：看动作做了没
nodes.explain:
forget / remember 后面接 to do 还是 doing，就看动作做了没有：

形式意思例句
forget / remember to do忘记 / 记得要去做（还没做）The light in the office is still on. He forgot to turn it off.（没关）/ Remember to go to the post office after school.（还没去）
forget / remember doing忘记 / 记得做过（已做）He forgot turning the light off.（其实关了，忘了关过）/ Don't you remember seeing the man before?（见过）

stop 更狠——直接换意思：

stop to do ＝ 停下（手头的事）去做另一件事：You are too tired. Stop to have a rest.（停下来去歇会儿）

stop doing ＝ 停止正在做的事：Stop talking. We are going to have the English class.（别说话了，要上课了）

记法：to do 朝前看（还没做的事），doing 装口袋（已经做过的事）；stop 后面直接跟的 doing 是「被停掉的事」，stop to do 里的 to do 是「停下来要奔向的新事」。

general_qs.stem: Don't forget ________ (come) tomorrow.
general_qs.explain: tomorrow 明天才来——动作还没发生 → forget to do（别忘了要来）→ to come。

general_qs.stem: The light in the office is still on. He forgot ________ it off.
general_qs.explain: 灯还亮着 → 关灯这事没做成 → forget to do（忘了要关）。B 死于 forget doing = 忘了做过——若选 B，灯早就灭了，跟 still on 矛盾。

general_qs.stem: I remember ________ (lock) the door before I left.
general_qs.explain: before I left——出门前锁门这事已经做过 → remember doing（记得锁过）→ locking。

general_qs.stem: Remember ________ to the post office after school.（现在还没去）
general_qs.explain: 放学后才去，现在还没去 → remember to do（记得要去）→ to go。B 死于 remember going = 记得去过——可你还没去。

general_qs.stem: You are too tired. Stop ________ a rest.
general_qs.explain: 停下（手头的事）去休息——rest 是停下来之后要做的新事 → stop to do → to have。B 死于 stop having = 把「休息」这件事停掉，正好说反。

general_qs.stem: Stop ________. We are going to have the English class.
general_qs.explain: 要上课了，停止「说话」这件事本身 → stop doing → talking。A 死于 stop to talk = 停下来去说话——正好和「要上课」拧着。

memory.front: forget / remember 接 to do 和 doing 差在哪？stop to do 和 stop doing 呢？
memory.back:
to do 没做：forget to do 忘了要做 / remember to do 记得要做
doing 已做：forget doing 忘了做过 / remember doing 记得做过
灯还亮着 → forgot to turn it off（没关成）
stop to do 停下来去做另一件事（Stop to have a rest.）
stop doing 停止正在做的事（Stop talking.）

nodes.title: ⑦ regret / try / mean / go on：to 朝前，doing 朝后
nodes.explain:
剩下四对「意思大变」的组合，一刀全切：to do 朝前（还没做 / 打算做），doing 朝后（已经做了 / 就是这件事）。

动词+ to do+ doing
regret遗憾要做（还没做）：I regret to tell you that you can't stay here.后悔做过（已做）：I regret eating so many donuts.
try尽力做（下决心努力）：Try to speak English as much as possible.尝试做（换方法看行不行）：I tried watching the movie, but I don't really like it.
mean打算做：I didn't mean to hurt you.意味着：Missing the bus means waiting for another 15 minutes.
go on接着做另一件事：After doing her homework, she went on to read a novel.继续做同一件事：After a short rest, she went on doing her homework.

⚠️ regret 特例：后面接 inform / announce / tell 这类「告知」动词时，用不定式——I regret to tell you…（我也不想这样告诉你，但是……）。

记法：to do 是「朝前看的新动作」，doing 是「兜里揣着的旧动作」；try 主语下决心 → to do，try 是试办法 → doing；mean 主语是人 → 打算，主语是事 → 意味着。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 2（下）：regret / try / mean / go on

general_qs.stem: I regret ________ you that you can't stay here.
general_qs.explain: regret 后接 tell / inform / announce 这类「告知」动词用不定式——遗憾地「要」告诉你（话还没出口）→ to tell。A 死于 telling = 后悔告诉过，话都说完了才谈不上遗憾地告知。

general_qs.stem: I regret ________ (eat) so many donuts now.（已经吃了）
general_qs.explain: 甜甜圈已经下肚 → 后悔做过 → regret doing → eating。同一个人，regret to tell 是话没说，regret eating 是事已做——方向决定形式。

general_qs.stem: Try ________ English as much as possible.（尽力多说）
general_qs.explain: try to do = 尽力做某事，句子里藏着「努力、下决心」→ to speak。A 死于 try speaking = 试试看说英语行不行，劲儿就泄了。

general_qs.stem: If you can't pull the door, try ________ (push) it.
general_qs.explain: 拉不开就「试试推」——换方法看管不管用 → try doing → pushing。和上一题对读：尽力做 → to do，试着换招 → doing。

general_qs.stem: I mean ________ (study) harder this semester.
general_qs.explain: 打算这学期更努力 → mean to do（打算做）→ to study。主语是人 I，脑子里的计划还没开工。

general_qs.stem: I didn't mean ________ you.
general_qs.explain: 我不是「故意要」伤害你——打算、意图 → mean to do → to hurt。A 死于 mean doing = 意味着，句子说不通；D 死于 hurt 的过去式还是 hurt，没有 hurted 这个词。

general_qs.stem: Being kind to others means ________ (treat) them with respect.
general_qs.explain: 主语是「善待他人」这件事（不是人）→ mean doing 意味着 → treating。善待他人「意味着」尊重他们——说的是客观含义，不是谁的打算。

general_qs.stem: After doing her homework, she went on ________ a novel.
general_qs.explain: 作业做完了，接着去读小说——另一件事 → go on to do → to read。A 死于 go on reading = 继续做同一件事（还在写作业）。

memory.front: regret / try / mean / go on，接 to do 和 doing 各是什么意思？
memory.back:
regret to do 遗憾要做（regret to tell you 告知类固定用不定式）/ regret doing 后悔做过
try to do 尽力做 / try doing 尝试做（换方法）
mean to do 打算做（主语是人）/ mean doing 意味着（主语是事）
go on to do 接着做另一件事 / go on doing 继续做同一件事
总口诀：to 朝前（还没做），doing 朝后（做了）

nodes.title: ⑧ need / require / want doing：主动表被动
nodes.explain:
need / require / want（需要）也能接 to do 和 doing，而且这一对接法方向相反：

形式意思例句
need to do需要（主语）去做I need to call someone to fix our windows.
need doing需要（主语）被做 ＝ need to be doneMy room needs cleaning every day. = My room needs to be cleaned every day.

房间是「被打扫」的，但英语偏用主动形式的 cleaning——这叫主动形式表被动。第 31 讲见过的 The plant needs watering 就是这一路，这里正式收编。

三个动词共享这条规则：need / require / want + doing 全都等于 + to be done，一副意思两身衣服。

记法：人是「主动去 need to do」，物是「躺着等 need doing」；看到物作主语 + need，就往 doing（或 to be done）上想。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 2（收尾）：need 主动表被动

general_qs.stem: My room needs ________ (clean) every day.
general_qs.explain: 房间是「被打扫」的 → need doing 主动表被动 → cleaning。物作主语，就别用 to clean 了。

general_qs.stem: 同义转换：My room needs cleaning every day. = My room needs ________ ________ ________ every day.（用 clean，3 词）
general_qs.explain: need doing = need to be done——主动形式的 cleaning 换上被动不定式 to be cleaned，意思分毫不动。

general_qs.stem: I need ________ (call) someone to fix our windows.
general_qs.explain: 主语 I 是人，我「主动去打」电话 → need to do → to call。和物等着「被做」的 need doing 方向正好相反。

general_qs.stem: The plants in the garden need ________ (water) every day.
general_qs.explain: 植物是「被浇」的 → need doing → watering（= need to be watered）。第 31 讲的老朋友，这里是课堂练习原题。

general_qs.stem: The bike is broken. It needs ________.
general_qs.explain: 车需要「被修」→ repairing（= to be repaired）。A 死于 to repair 是车自己去修别人；C 死于 need 后面不直接接过去分词。

general_qs.stem: The flowers want ________.（需要浇水）
general_qs.explain: want 和 need / require 一个套路：want doing = want to be done → watering。花是「被浇」的，主动形式表被动。

memory.front: need doing 是什么意思？等于什么？哪三个动词都吃这套规则？
memory.back:
need / require / want + doing ＝ + to be done（主动形式表被动）
My room needs cleaning. = My room needs to be cleaned.
The plants need watering every day.
物作主语等着「被做」→ doing；人主动去做 → need to do

nodes.title: ⑨ 综合验收：八关考点一锅端
nodes.explain:
最后一关，不讲新东西——把前面八关的考点混在一起再过一遍。做错哪题，就回哪一关翻口诀卡。

验收清单：动名词作主语（三单谓语 + it 形式主语）· doing 名单与介词 to 陷阱（③④）· like 家一次与一贯（⑤）· forget / remember 看做没做（⑥）· mean / go on 看方向（⑦）· need doing 主动表被动（⑧）。
nodes.qs_label: 综合验收（错哪题回哪关）

general_qs.stem: ________ too much is bad for your health.
general_qs.explain: 「吃得太多」这件事作主语 → 动名词 Eating（回③）。A / C 死于动词原形和三单都不能直接作主语；D 死于 to 后面不能跟 doing。

general_qs.stem: I suggest ________ to the museum this weekend.
general_qs.explain: suggest（建议）在 doing 名单上 → going（回④）。A 死于 suggest 不接 to do。

general_qs.stem: Don't forget ________ the light when you leave the room.
general_qs.explain: 走的时候才关灯——动作还没做 → forget to do（别忘了要做）→ to turn off（回⑥）。B 死于 forget doing = 忘了关过。

general_qs.stem: Missing the bus means ________ (wait) for another 15 minutes.
general_qs.explain: 主语是「错过公交」这件事 → mean doing 意味着 → waiting（回⑦）。事作主语谈的是客观后果，不是谁的打算。

general_qs.stem: After a short rest, she went on ________ her homework.
general_qs.explain: 休息之后接着做同一份作业 → go on doing（回⑦）。A 死于 go on to do 是接着做另一件事。

general_qs.stem: My hair is too long. It needs ________ (cut).
general_qs.explain: 头发需要「被剪」→ need doing 主动表被动 → cutting（= needs to be cut）（回⑧）。
